name: open_quadrant
description: Open a URL in the user's default browser, positioned in a screen quadrant (top_left, top_right, bottom_left, bottom_right). Set new_window=true to open a fresh browser window instead of a tab.

quadrant.description: Screen quadrant: top_left, top_right, bottom_left, or bottom_right.

new_window.description: If true, launch a new browser window (Chrome/Edge/Firefox). Default false (opens a tab in the existing window).
